editorial:
Imagine getting out of prison only to find out your old partner ripped you off. That is exactly what happens to Roman. He heads to a sunny beach hotel to get the money he is owed, but the owner tries to pay him off with a small amount of cash. Instead of leaving, Roman decides to move in and make the owner's life a living hell until he gets every cent. The movie starts off feeling like a slow burn in a pretty vacation spot, but it quickly turns into a stressful game of cat and mouse. You can feel the tension building as the sunny scenery clashes with the dark plans these men have for each other.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing about who is actually in control. The acting is solid, and the way the plot twists keep you on the edge of your seat. While some parts of the middle feel a bit slow, the payoff is worth it. If you enjoy thrillers where greed leads to total chaos, you will love this. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move to keep this gem forever.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when the greed and lies finally catch up to everyone. After a series of betrayals and fights, the tension reaches a breaking point. Roman finds out that the money is not as easy to get as he thought. In the final scenes, the violence peaks and the hotel owner is defeated. It ends with a bleak feeling, showing that chasing money and revenge usually leaves you with nothing but a ruined life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime stories with a lot of tension and unexpected turns.
